dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Whoa, did you two see that? A bird with huuuge wings just flew by!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: If Master Tighnari was here, he'd be able to tell you its scientific name, species, and behaviors...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: But as for me... all I can tell you is, it isn't a species we have in Sumeru...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Oh? Then what kinds of birds do you have in Sumeru?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Dusk Birds! They have the most beautiful, vibrant colors. The feathers on their chest are the color of ripe Sunsettias, and their wing-tips are the color of tender Mint leaves.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: They're not too skittish around people, and at my tree holl— I mean, this tree that I often go past, there's a Dusk Bird there that always looks at me like it understands what I'm saying.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I once picked up one of its feathers from the ground, and it felt really nice...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: You have keen observation skills, and a love for living things. You'd be better served directing your energies there rather than sighing and whining all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Ugh, Eula says things in the most awkward way possible sometimes... Just ignore the second half, Collei!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: No, it's fine, I know what she means. She does have a point...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Are you hungry for fish? I see quite a few over there.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Sounds like someone's up for a fishing contest, huh? Fair warning, though, I won't lose!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Seriously...? Another competition? I thought we were supposed to be sightseeing. ...Uh, but still — wait for me!
